description: This Java test class contains unit tests for utility functions within the Sales Manager project, specifically testing cache operations, currency functionalities, and geolocation services.

classes.name: UtilsTestCase
classes.description: A JUnit test class for validating utility functions like caching, currency formatting, and geolocation within the Sales Manager application.

methods.name: testCache
methods.description: Tests the caching mechanism by storing and retrieving a list of countries from the cache.

methods.name: testCurrency
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of currency information and formatting for a specific currency code.

methods.name: testGeoLocation
methods.description: Tests the geolocation service by retrieving address information based on an IP address.
